newsitem.title: CHINA: China's Huludao zinc Jan-May 97 output up 40 pct.
newsitem.headline: China's Huludao zinc Jan-May 97 output up 40 pct.

text.p: China's Huludao Zinc Smelter produced 125,560 tonnes of zinc metal in the first five months of 1997, up 40.6 percent on the same period of 1996, the China Nonferrous Metals News said.
Total zinc metal exports in the first five months of the year were 28,152 tonnes, worth $32.94 million, it said, without giving a comparative figure.
Income from sales in the first five months of 1997 was 1.522 billon yuan ($183 million), it said, without a comparison.
The paper, published in Beijing on June 19, was seen in Shanghai on Monday.

Output of non-ferrous products totalled 150,029 tonnes, up 36.8 percent on the year-ago period, with output of chemical products totalling 294,276 tonnes, up 29.8 percent on the year-ago period, it said.
Total output value, at 1990 prices, was 989.69 million yuan, 29 percent higher that last year, with tax payable of 161.57 million yuan and profits of 58.18 million yuan, it said.
Huludao manufactured 33,966 tonnes of electrolytic zinc in the first five months of 1997, up 316 percent on the same period last year, it said.
Sulphate production in the first five months of 1997 reached 28,781 tonnes, up 30.7 percent on the same period last year, it said.
